title: FluxerCraft
description: A Fluxer client in the Minecraft Chat window
body:
Make your Minecraft chat into a Fluxer client! See Gallery for looks.

### Usage

```
/fluxer token
/fluxer glist
/fluxer clist <n>
/fluxer enter <g> <c>
/fluxer send <text>
/fluxer leave
```
*while inside of a channel you can just send text to the chat and it will automatically be forwarded to the Fluxer channel

**I plan to add voice chat support as part of 1.0 aka Stable release. I plan to make a Fluxer version of [Simple Voice Chat Discord Bridge](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat-discord-bridge) but that will be it's own separate mod but the code will be based on FluxerCraft**
